name: How long does it take to install new windows in a home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new windows in a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window installation varies based on the number of windows, their type, and the complexity of the project. For a typical home, installing a few standard-sized windows might take a day or two. A full-house replacement with many windows or custom installations could extend to several days or even a week. We aim to minimize disruption and will provide a clear timeline estimate after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on the number and type of windows. A few windows might take 1-2 days, while a full house replacement could take several days to a week.
